aspects.says: --add-opens module/package=target, or the Add-Opens attribute of an executable jar's manifest, opens one package; a module-info.java can open only its own packages.
basis: section:Open One Package by Name, or Stop Reaching Inside
aspects.reason: a launcher option or manifest attribute is configuration the graded runner does not let a practice set; the practice grades what the code does without it

aspects.says: From Java 17, setAccessible(true) on a private member of a JDK package that is not opened throws InaccessibleObjectException, and trySetAccessible() returns false instead.
basis: section:Java 17 Refuses Deep Reflection into the JDK, and --illegal-access Is Gone

aspects.says: Java 17 removed --illegal-access; the JVM ignores the option with a warning, so no flag restores the behaviour of Java 9 to 15.
basis: section:Java 17 Refuses Deep Reflection into the JDK, and --illegal-access Is Gone

aspects.says: On Java 21 the new algorithms live in the jdk.random module, found through ServiceLoader, so a jlink image built from jdeps' module list lacks them and RandomGeneratorFactory.of throws IllegalArgumentException.
basis: section:Spot the Problem: A Trimmed Runtime Has No Algorithms

aspects.says: The new algorithms are not thread-safe: shared across threads they repeat values with no exception, so each thread gets a generator of its own.
basis: section:A Generator Shared Across Threads Is Either Slow or Wrong

aspects.says: InaccessibleObjectException is unchecked and not a SecurityException, so reflective code that catches SecurityException and IllegalAccessException lets it through.
basis: section:Java 17 Refuses Deep Reflection into the JDK, and --illegal-access Is Gone

aspects.says: Strong encapsulation closes the private members of JDK packages; public members of exported packages stay reachable by reflection.
basis: section:Java 17 Refuses Deep Reflection into the JDK, and --illegal-access Is Gone

aspects.says: The Security Manager is deprecated for removal since 17; since 18 setSecurityManager throws UnsupportedOperationException unless the JVM starts with -Djava.security.manager=allow, and javac --release 11 hides the removal warnings.
basis: section:The Security Manager Still Compiles, Warns, and Since 18 Refuses to Install

aspects.says: A random sequence is fixed by the algorithm and the seed: RandomGeneratorFactory.of(name).create(seed) replays, while RandomGenerator.of(name) takes no seed and getDefault() may change algorithm over time.
basis: section:RandomGenerator Names the Algorithm, and Replay Needs the Algorithm and the Seed

aspects.says: A shared java.util.Random is thread-safe but every draw contends on one field, so many threads drawing from it are far slower than ThreadLocalRandom.current().
basis: section:A Generator Shared Across Threads Is Either Slow or Wrong
aspects.reason: contention is a timing effect that differs by machine; no deterministic test can grade it

aspects.says: A ThreadLocalRandom stored in a field and used by threads that never called current() draws from unseeded per-thread state, so those threads repeat the same numbers after every restart.
basis: section:A Generator Shared Across Threads Is Either Slow or Wrong
